input.summary: Plunge the upper-left lane to light the three numbered mushroom bumpers. Relight and hit those bumpers to spell THEREDMAX, then collect the letter bonus at the upper-right saucer.

quickInfo.name: Upper-left lane
quickInfo.summary: The upper-left lane lights all three numbered mushroom bumpers and is usually available only on the plunge.

quickInfo.name: Bumper relights
quickInfo.summary: The center mushroom lights bumper 1, while a full captive-ball hit lights bumpers 2 and 3.

quickInfo.name: THEREDMAX letters
quickInfo.summary: Each lit numbered-bumper hit adds one THEREDMAX letter and turns that bumper off.

quickInfo.name: Letter bonus
quickInfo.summary: Each lit T-H-E letter adds 1K, each R-E-D letter adds 3K, and each M-A-X letter adds 5K to bonus.

quickInfo.name: Center post
quickInfo.summary: The mushroom right of the captive ball raises the center post, while the mushroom left of it lowers the post.

steps.text: Plunge through the upper-left lane to light all three numbered mushroom bumpers.
Hit the mushroom right of the captive ball to raise the center post.
Hit each lit numbered mushroom bumper to add a THEREDMAX letter.
Use the center mushroom to relight bumper 1.
Drive the captive ball fully backward to relight bumpers 2 and 3.
Repeat the relight-and-hit cycle to raise the letter bonus.
When the built bonus justifies the shot, shoot the upper-right saucer to collect it.

fallback.title: Saucer-miss upper recovery
fallback.when: Use this plan when a controlled upper-right saucer shot passes over or around the saucer.

steps.text: Follow the ball into the upper area after the missed saucer entry.
Nudge toward the upper-left lane to relight all three numbered bumpers.
If that lane is unavailable, use a white rollover to light a pop-bumper pair.
Let the ball approach the saucer from above instead of forcing another direct shot.

alternatives.title: Upper pop-bumper scoring
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the ball reaches the upper area but cannot enter the upper-left lane or saucer.

steps.text: Guide the ball over the left white rollover to light the yellow pop bumpers.
Use the right white rollover to light the green pop bumpers.
Keep the ball in the upper area while the lit bumpers score.
Return to the numbered-bumper route when the ball reaches the lower playfield.
Plunge the upper-left lane to light the numbered mushroom bumpers.
Relight and hit them until THEREDMAX is complete.
Hit the mushroom to the right of the captive ball to raise the center post before the collect attempt.
Shoot the upper-right saucer to collect the 27K letter bonus.

techniques.name: Micro-flip
techniques.instruction: Micro-flip a ball resting on the raised center post into a controlled flipper cradle.

techniques.name: Full captive-ball stroke
techniques.instruction: Drive the captive ball fully backward to light bumpers 2 and 3. A weak or grazing hit can light only bumper 2.

techniques.name: Upper-area choice
techniques.instruction: When the ball returns to the top, guide it to the upper-left lane, a white rollover, or the upper-right saucer.

cautions.issue: The upper-right saucer has no backstop, so the ball can skip over or around it.
cautions.response: Treat each miss as an upper-play opportunity. Do not repeat the direct shot until its entry proves reliable.

cautions.issue: A numbered mushroom bumper turns off after it awards a letter.
cautions.response: Relight that bumper before another hit. Do not expect an unlit hit to add a letter.

cautions.issue: The mushroom left of the captive ball lowers the center post.
cautions.response: Check the post before you use it for control. Relight it from the right mushroom when necessary.

cautions.issue: A side-lane drain collects letter bonus, but a center drain does not.
cautions.response: Use the upper-right saucer for an in-ball collect when its entry is reliable.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Red Max edition, ball count, and letter-progress behavior.
Test center post, saucer, rollovers, and side-lane feeds.

input.simpleOverview: The Red Max turns lit hits on three numbered mushroom bumpers into T-H-E-R-E-D-M-A-X letters and a growing collect. Plunge the upper-left lane to light the bumpers, relight them with the center mushroom or captive ball, then shoot the upper-right saucer after all nine letters are complete.
